summary.headline: Mars in Earthly and Airy Triplicities
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Mars’s combustion in the earthy and airy triplicities, covering kings, emirs, soldiers, markets, crops, diseases, weather, winds, and social unrest. The effects of Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon when placed in or aspecting each triplicity are specified.
